hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts annual CapEx-to-D&A replacement-cycle acceleration (CapEx/D&A rising into a productive range, revenue not contracting, and CapEx growth not wildly outpacing revenue) paired with liquid SPY-relative leadership may identify reinvestment-cycle winners with 10-day continuation beyond generic momentum.

prediction.confidence_reason: The D&A and fixed-asset turnover scouts were positive in aggregate but failed old_thin/drawdown; both explicitly named capex-to-D&A replacement-cycle context as materially different PIT evidence. The risk is high because recent raw Companyfacts quality sources often relabel liquid momentum and fail at least one canonical window.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual CapEx/D&A/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, excluded sector, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual CapEx/D&A reinvestment-cycle gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
